question_text: Will ChatGPT have transaction fees before Jan 1, 2026?
resolution_criteria:
If ChatGPT has implemented transaction fees before Jan 1, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
The function must be live and processing user interactions, not labeled as beta/test/experimental, and officially acknowledged by the company through announcements or documentation. Implementation includes direct integration into the product's interface, automatic application to user accounts, user-initiated activation through official controls, API implementation, or policy changes that operationally enforce the function. Announcements without deployment, employee-only testing, technical documentation without implementation, and third-party additions without authorization do not qualify. The implementation must occur in the United States unless otherwise specified.
